Simply put, this thermometer/hygrometer is a great value! I was looking for an inexpensive hygrometer to monitor the humidity in multiple dry-food storage containers. I first purchased a Caliber III and a Caliber IV humidor hygrometers due to their reputation for accuracy. However, they are expensive, so I wanted to find a less expensive hygrometer to keep a hygrometer in each food container.

I purchased five units to test, and to compare to the more expensive Caliber hygrometers. I was impressed with the five Amir Digital Thermometer/Hygrometers, and while the Caliber units seem to be superior, at approximately 1/3 the cost, I decided that the less expensive units satisfied my needs.

I purchased 15 additional units, but found five of them were defective. One had a defective display, the other four failed to "turn on" after inserting the battery. I managed to get three of the four to work after inserting a cardboard spacer on top of the battery, so the battery would be pushed slightly further into the battery compartment. When Amir was informed of my experience, they offered to refund the cost of all five units! I ordered five replacement units, and all five worked as intended. I am very impressed with Amir's customer service!!!

The first one I got for use in my incubator read about a degree low. However, it fit in an egg cup, and the numbers are decent size to read through the incubator's viewing pane. Since I often use 2 tabletop incubators at once, I ordered this one, very similar, for the other unit. It has the same problem with reading low when compared to my house thermostat, my cabinet and tabletop incubator scales, and a couple other small hygrometers. The humidity reading is more accurate, so I put 2 different types in each incubator. On this one, I wrote "+1" by the temp so I remember to add a degree to get the correct reading. The other type is bigger and reads low on humidity, so I prefer this overall.

I needed to vent a new dryer I purchased out of a window, I found this product and after using it for two months I find it review worthy. This vent is heavy duty, slides out to fit the window opening and works like a dream, when I have to dry a load of laundry I lift up the window screen and secure it with a clothes pin, put the vent that's attached to a flexible dryer hose into the window, close the window to the top of the vent and turn the dryer on and remove it when I'm done, the vent is made so well I expect it will last for years. I just wish it didn't cost so much but I wouldn't hesitate to buy another one as a gift for someone or recommend it as a great alternative to drilling a permanent vent opening thru a wall.

Update; Well it finally happened I put wet clothes into the dryer and lifted the vent to put into the window, my hands were wet and the vent slipped out of my hands falling approximately 40 inches to the tile floor after bouncing off my dryer, the dryer has a small scratch and the tile has a small dent in it but the vent suffered no damage at all and that my fellow reviewers is how well this vent is made.

I'm a bit worried bugs or rodents could come in but as I'm heading into fall/winter this shouldn't happen... I hope it doesn't freeze shut in the winter. Those are my only concerns. As for the product it self it was very easy to adjust to the window. I put tape all around my window so that no air would come in or escape and bugs would not get in at the top. For living in an apartment and buying a washer/dryer so I don't have to use the ones downstairs and pay each time this was defiantly a good investment to ensure the room doesn't get too hot

Holy cow, this thing is amazing. I had a second floor laundry hookup but no vent for the gas dryer, only a window. I did some searching around and found this thing. This vent is a solid metal sturdy build, and adjusts to fit perfectly in the window. I did add a bit of foam around the edges, the same stuff you would use to seal off an air conditioner, so that cold air can't seem in from the edges during winter. This thing is a must have if you are looking for an easy way to vent out a window rather than making an entire new hole for a dryer. I tried it at the top and at the bottom of the window. It works either way, but I thought it looked better at the bottom so I stuck with that. The flap only opens one way so no worries about anything coming in.

It took a couple tries to get this right, but the key to using this product was course ground coffee and (in my case) much more coffee than the instructions said. I like my coffee strong. I tried pre-ground coffee and the grounds flooded the cup (yuck). You can also insert mini-filters used on other reusable k-cups, but that probably defeats some of the purpose. The tea option worked well. I love loose leaf tea. :)

Product does exactly as intended. Comes in no-fuss packaging. The instructions for use are right on the box (not that you really need instructions for this) so you don't need to deal with worthless paper instructions stuffed in the box.

Coffee pour-over attachment filters the water through at an ideal rate to create a perfect cup of coffee. A great product for single cups of coffee. Product seems to be well-made and easily washable.

I would recommend this product to anyone in the market for a pour-over coffee or tea filter.

Great idea and they work well, providing the options I want for tea and coffee. HOWEVER...the inside lining (see in the photo as black plastic bars across the filter) started falling apart after ONE use. Did I get plastic in my coffee? No, the filter presents that...but it is still a technical flaw and concern that limits my rating. Still use and enjoy once in a while.

Finally! Finally, I have a re-usable K-cup that works! I have bought 3 or 4 re-usable pods from local stores (Walmart, Target, and a grocery store). The biggest disappointment is when my coffee just clogs into a big mass in the pod & I end up with week coffee. When I saw this one, right out of the box, I thought it was going to be the same thing. Thank GOD that this works. I have to get used to adjusting the right amount of grounds to get a balance of "not to strong, not too weak" because with the old re-usables, I couldn't get it strong enough. I got this at a HUGE discount, but I'm going to be ordering another couple of sets asap to have around the house.

If you have tried the usual plastic-lidded re-usable pods (you know the kind from a store), you have to try this one. It really does work. I've had the other re-usables and was still buying the expensive Keurig pods because I couldn't get a decent cup without them. Dunkin Donuts and Cafe Bustelo are my faves because they are strong. D.D. is around $12.00 for something like 16 pods at our local Walmart (this IS Alaska), and for Cafe Bustelo, I was paying around $10 and change for 18 pods. At our Costco, I was paying up to $40+ for 100 pods of different name varieties. Crazy. I can get 2lbs of fresh ground of the good Seattle Mountain French Roast (SO good) for around $13-$15.
